text:
maya rao: Quick: final social push for Sunrise demo tomorrow AM. Need one two-line X hook, LinkedIn longpost, hero image, and who owns replies. :sunrise:
drew fox: exporting hero (16:9) and square thumb now. will add alt text and drop path.
sam irwin: I'll make the X hook technical and LN narrative. Posting drafts in 2.
olivia chan: I'll prep reply templates for pricing, setup time, and privacy. aiming for 6 short replies.
drew fox: uploaded to /marketing/assets/sunrise/hero.mp4 and /marketing/assets/sunrise/thumb1.jpg. alt text included.
maya rao: UTM pattern: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}&utm_campaign=sunrise_q2&utm_content={variant} replace {variant} with x-tech / ln-story.
sam irwin: X: "Ship LLM features without the latency hangover. Sunrise keeps inference fast and predictable. Demo: <link>?utm_content=x-tech"
sam irwin: LinkedIn: "Teams building with LLMs need predictable latency, clear cost signals, and simple rollouts. Sunrise combines a high-throughput runtime with observability so engineers ship confidently. Join our demo to see the dashboard and a 10-min setup guide. <link>?utm_content=ln-story"
maya rao: social-scheduler: queue X for 08:30 PST (hook + hero + thumb1) and LinkedIn for 09:00 PST (LN longpost + static).
social-scheduler: confirmed. preflight ping scheduled for 07:55 PST.
olivia chan: posted first 3 reply templates in thread: pricing, models, private deployment notes. will finish rest by 07:50.
maya rao: routing: DMs -> sam, comments -> community triage. sam will escalate sales-intent to SDRs.
social-scheduler: preflight completed at 07:56 PST: assets present, UTMs validated, posts queued.
maya rao: great work. after 2 hours sam, send a quick engagement summary (impressions + top replies).
sam irwin: will do. good luck everyone :thumbsup:
